description: This mod is a Cobblemon add-on that adds Lucky Blocks, which can drop Pokémon or items! Loot is customizable via item tags. Lucky Blocks are craftable or found in dungeons (chest loot configurable). This version is an unofficial Fabric 1.21.1 port.

mods.name: Cobblemon Lucky Blocks
mods.description: A Lucky Block Mod for Cobblemon! Adds lucky blocks that can give random Pokémon or items.
